name: git-gremlin
description: Git commit, review-comment discipline, and GitHub PR helper for Codex with stronger automatic skill triggers and scoped mutation gates.

interface.shortDescription: Prepare commits, handle review comments, and publish PR branches safely
interface.longDescription: Git Gremlin bundles Codex skills for recognizing commit and GitHub PR intent from natural prompts, drafting conventional commit messages and PR descriptions from git context, staging dirty changes when an actual commit needs them, publishing local branches after the PR confirmation gate, and keeping review-comment replies honest.
defaultPrompt: Use Git Gremlin to commit my changes.
Use Git Gremlin to open a GitHub PR for this branch.
Use Git Gremlin to handle the review comments on this PR.
